title: Globex Robotics
description: Deploy and monitor robot fleets with the Globex SDK.

The Globex SDK connects your backend to every robot in your fleet: register
units, dispatch missions, and stream telemetry — all through one TypeScript
client.

## How a fleet is organized

- **Fleet** — a named group of robots sharing a deployment site and policy.
- **Robot** — a single unit, identified by serial number. A robot belongs to
  exactly one fleet and reports its own battery, pose, and mission state.
- **Mission** — a queued unit of work (patrol, pick, dock). Missions are
  executed in order per robot and report progress events until terminal.

## Install

```bash
bun add @globex/sdk
```

The client authenticates with a fleet token from the Globex console:

```ts
import { Globex } from "@globex/sdk"

const globex = new Globex({ token: process.env.GLOBEX_FLEET_TOKEN })
```
